subject.title: fix: preserve quoted replies in text sends

question: Should --reply-to-sender continue supporting unsynced group replies when the quoted message is absent from the local store, or should that documented workflow now fail closed?
rationale: The branch's stricter behavior fixes silent quote loss but removes an existing documented fallback, and source evidence alone cannot determine whether that compatibility break is intended.

options.title: Preserve the fallback
options.body: Keep the stored-message implementation for complete quotes while retaining the explicit --reply-to-sender path for unsynced group targets with focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed behavior
options.body: Intentionally reject unsynced quote targets, update the command documentation and diagnostics, and treat the change as an upgrade-visible contract correction.

recommendation.title: Preserve the fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the stored-message implementation for complete quotes while retaining the explicit --reply-to-sender path for unsynced group targets with focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: As the current repository maintainer, this person is the strongest available owner for the CLI compatibility decision.
